brand.name: Tesla
brand.voice: Minimal. Confident. Forward-looking. Let the product speak. No hype — just facts and quiet authority.

icps.label: Tech-Forward Early Adopter
pain_points: Wants the most advanced car on the road
Cares about OTA updates and software-defined features
Frustrated by legacy automakers' slow innovation

copy.headline:
THE SOFTWARE
IS THE CAR.
copy.subline:
Over-the-air updates. Full self-driving hardware.
The car that gets better while you sleep.

visual_treatment.background_mood: Dark minimal abstract environment. Subtle grid lines on the ground, like a digital plane materializing. Deep charcoal and black tones. Faint geometric light patterns. Very dark at top and bottom edges for text contrast. No clutter — pure negative space.

icps.label: Eco-Conscious Executive
pain_points: Wants to reduce carbon footprint without sacrificing luxury
Needs a car that matches their professional status
Tired of gas station stops and maintenance appointments

copy.headline:
ZERO EMISSIONS.
ZERO COMPROMISE.
copy.subline:
396-mile range. No gas. No oil changes.
The future of driving, today.

visual_treatment.background_mood: Clean, open landscape at dawn. Soft golden light on rolling green hills, wind turbines far in the distance. Expansive sky with gentle clouds. Muted, calming palette. Very dark gradient at top and bottom edges for text contrast.

icps.label: Performance & Speed Enthusiast
pain_points: Wants the fastest production sedan, period
Cares about 0-60, quarter mile, track performance
Skeptical that electric can beat combustion — needs proof

copy.headline: 1.99 SECONDS.
copy.subline:
0-60 mph. 1,020 hp. Tri-motor AWD.
The quickest production car ever made.

visual_treatment.background_mood: Dark dramatic track environment at night. Wet tarmac reflecting faint red light. Motion blur in background suggesting extreme speed. Black and red tones. Cinematic, intense. Very dark at top and bottom edges.

icps.label: Luxury Sedan Upgrader
pain_points: Currently drives a BMW/Mercedes/Audi and wants something more modern
Values interior quality, comfort, and status
Wants a quieter, smoother driving experience

copy.headline:
SILENCE
IS POWER.
copy.subline:
Glass roof. 17" touchscreen. White interior.
396 miles of whisper-quiet performance.

visual_treatment.background_mood: Elegant modern architecture at dusk. Clean concrete and glass building, warm interior light spilling out. Muted earth tones, sophisticated and understated. Minimal, editorial. Dark gradient at top and bottom edges for text.
